metadata.title: Team Cymru Scout Enrich Incident
metadata.description: This playbook will fetch and ingest IP or Domain Indicator data based on Entity mapped in Microsoft Sentinel Incident and notify to pre-defined or user customizable email id.
prerequisites: 1. User should have an outlook mail account in order to use this playbook.
postDeployment: This playbook writes to Log Analytics through the Logs Ingestion API using its own system-assigned managed identity. The data collection endpoint, the data collection rule, the destination tables and the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment are all created by this template, so ingestion needs no manual authorization.
If you ran an earlier version of this playbook, its tables were created by the retired HTTP Data Collector API and must be converted once per workspace before the first run:
az monitor log-analytics workspace table migrate --resource-group <resource-group> --workspace-name <workspace> --table-name <Table>_CL
This conversion cannot be undone. The playbook README lists every table it writes.
Once deployment is complete, authorize each connection.
1. Go to your logic app → API connections → Select a connection resource
2. Go to General → Edit API connection
**c. Assign Role to add comment in incident**
1. Go to Log Analytics Workspace → <your workspace> → Access Control → Add
5.Members: select managed identity for assigned access to and add your logic app as member

metadata.description: Enter username of your Team Cymru Scout account.
Enter password of your Team Cymru Scout account.
Enter Base URL of your Team Cymru Scout account.(e.g. https://scout.cymru.com)
Enter valid comma separated email ID(s) of receiver without space. (e.g. person1@gmail.com,person2@gmail.com)
Enter the log analytics workspace name in which data will be stored for incident enrichment.

inputs.body:
@{variables('pdns_table_name')}_CL
| where ip_s == "@{items('For_Each_IP_Address')}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ip_s, domain_s
| project-rename domain=domain_s, event_count=event_count_d
| sort by event_count
| take 10

@{variables('open_ports_table_name')}_CL
| where ip_s == "@{items('For_Each_IP_Address')}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by service_s, port_d, protocol_d, protocol_text_s
| project-rename port=port_d, protocol=protocol_d, protocol_text=protocol_text_s, event_count=event_count_d
| sort by event_count
| take 10

@{variables('fingerprints_table_name')}_CL
| where ip_s == "@{items('For_Each_IP_Address')}"
| extend SignatureG = column_ifexists('signature_g', '')
| extend SignatureS = column_ifexists('signature_s', '')
| extend Signature = coalesce(SignatureG, SignatureS)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by type_s, Signature, port_d
| project-rename type=type_s, port=port_d, first_seen=first_seen_s, last_seen=last_seen_s, signature=Signature, count=count_d
| sort by count
| take 10

@{variables('whois_table_name')}_CL
| where ip_s == "@{items('For_Each_IP_Address')}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ip_s
| project-rename modified=modified_s, asn=asn_d, cidr=cidr_s, as_name=as_name_s, bgp_asn=bgp_asn_d, bgp_asn_name=bgp_asn_name_s, net_name=net_name_s, cc=cc_s, description=description_s, admin_contact_id=admin_contact_id_s, admin_contact_role=admin_contact_role_s, admin_contact_email=admin_contact_email_s, 
admin_contact_phone=admin_contact_phone_s,
admin_contact_country=admin_contact_country_s, admin_contact_address=admin_contact_address_s, tech_contact_id=tech_contact_id_s, tech_contact_role=tech_contact_role_s, tech_contact_email=tech_contact_email_s, tech_contact_phone=tech_contact_phone_s, tech_contact_country=tech_contact_country_s, tech_contact_address=tech_contact_address_s, org_id=org_id_s, org_name=org_name_s, org_email=org_email_s, org_phone=org_phone_s, org_country=org_country_s, org_address=org_address_s, mnt_by_email=mnt_by_email_s, mnt_router_email=mnt_router_email_s

@{variables('insights_table_name')}_CL
| where ip_s == "@{items('For_Each_IP_Address')}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by rank_d, Message
| top 10 by rank_d
| project-rename rating=rating_s, message=Message
